integrity: The exact formula is derived from coordinates and the standard circular-segment area formula. The first variation and stability obstruction are analytic. The included standard-library program checks representative coordinate identities and asymptotics only and is not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The explicit constant is a lower bound generated by the canonical one-vertex deformation; global optimality for finite \(r\) is not claimed. The exact calculation is Euclidean and does not cover the spherical or hyperbolic variants. A poorly indexed prior calculation of the same elementary first variation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact first variation of the canonical \(r\)-disk Pál stability witness
